theorems.name: Submission.rsod_graphChart_injective_contDiffOn_fderiv_injective
theorems.statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (x₀ : Amb n ℓ) (Ω : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u Ω → Function.Injective (fun x => q (graphPoint x (u x)) + x₀) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => q (graphPoint x (u x)) + x₀) Ω ∧ ∀ x ∈ Ω, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun x => q (graphPoint x (u x)) + x₀) x)
